reviewNotes: Reviewed all 502 speech keys from 100 cards against data/real-conversation-400-4.json source furigana and accepted vocabulary readings. Sentence/cloze prompts and full-sentence explanations use 1.0; standalone vocabulary and very short choices use 0.85. Topic/contrast は -> わ selected by exact key and occurrence, including では, てはいけません and short 最近では/今後は/実際には/昔は/将来は/以前は choices. Lexical しゅくはく, はいって/はいった, はじめました, じゅうはっさい, こうはい, はたらきやすい/はたらきかた/はたらきました/はたらく, はつげん, はずかしい, はらわなくて, しはらい, おはかまいり, はんかがい, はやく, はで, はたけ and はなす/はなしました preserved. Directional 家族への and 温泉へ -> かぞくえの and おんせんえ; lexical へや, しゅうへん, へっています and へり retained. Every を checked as object particle -> お. Corrected explanation 社会人 from しゃかいにん to しゃかいじん and 人手不足 from ひとでふそく to ひとでぶそく using the accepted vocabulary readings. Katakana converted to hiragana preserving long vowels/gemination (こつ, まなー, こーひー, ぐるめ, るーる, ぱーてぃー). Final punctuation added to fragments. Display labels and distinct lookup keys unchanged. Text review only; audible articulation and pitch accent not verified.
